close $fp

synth_design -top uart_tx -flatten_hierarchy rebuilt 
set fp [open "C:/Users/prince.baah/Downloads/autortl-work/logs/harness-uart-tx-03/iter_001/cand_standard/timing_io.tcl" w]

close $fp
